description: This file defines the OfbizUrlBuilder class, which provides methods to construct full or partial URLs within the OFBiz web application framework, handling host, scheme, and path components based on configuration and request context.

classes.name: OfbizUrlBuilder
classes.description: A utility class for constructing URLs within the OFBiz web application, supporting full URL and host/path components based on configuration and request context.

methods.name: from (HttpServletRequest request)
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an OfbizUrlBuilder instance based on the current HTTP request, utilizing request attributes and configuration.

methods.name: from (WebappInfo webAppInfo, Delegator delegator)
methods.description: Creates an OfbizUrlBuilder instance using web application info and delegator, suitable for scheduled jobs or contexts without an HTTP request.

methods.name: buildFullUrl
methods.description: Constructs a complete URL including scheme, host, servlet path, and resource, returning true if HTTPS is used.

methods.name: buildHostPart
methods.description: Builds the scheme and host part of the URL, determining HTTPS usage based on configuration and request map.

methods.name: buildPathPart
methods.description: Builds the path part of the URL, including servlet path and resource.
